actions: Open template-free generated input without repair
Enter fourteen controlled GCD/LCM formulas through native formula editors
Enter a one-cell range and observe normalization to native single-cell AST nodes
Save, close and reopen native reference
Preserve the text operand type while changing text 12 to text 18
Inspect recalculated results, save, close and reopen changed native source
Export baseline and changed XLSX with one worksheet per table and no overview worksheet
controls: Boolean references cache 1 for GCD and 6 for LCM; they remain partial
Arbitrary text produces native error cells; it remains partial
nativeAcceptance.sourceOperandType: TextCell independently confirmed before and after native edits
nativeAcceptance.nativeXlsxPlacement: Both tables offset one row and column; native source B4 maps to Excel C5. OfficeIMO uses table-relative grids.
nativeAcceptance.independentDecoder: numbers-parser 4.19.0; verify-numbers-integer-text.py uses no OfficeIMO assembly

limits: Canonical ASCII nonnegative integer text in direct scalar cell references, within 999999999999999 and the existing conservative LCM product bound.
Wider text ranges, blank references, Booleans, noncanonical/localized text, formula dependencies, merges and larger integer domains remain partial.
The native source includes padding and unsupported formula controls; no complete reconstruction or composed-PDF claim.
No Apple/destination typography, layout equivalence, additional application-version, architecture or physical-device qualification.
